label: PHASE_T_EXTERNAL_DATA_DECISION_V1
rationale: FineDiving and similar datasets contain high-resolution diving video. At 360p proxy scale, diver appears at ~5-15% of frame height. Training on high-resolution diving data and applying at 360p would maintain the domain gap. External data becomes relevant if: (a) original resolution processing is enabled, or (b) a 360p-specific diving detection dataset is created. Phase L domain adaptation on in-distribution 360p crops is a more appropriate first step.
reconsider_when: Original resolution (1080p/4K) video processing is enabled
Phase L shows VIABLE fine-tuning but lacks sufficient training data (N < 100 dives)
